issue_description: Critical alignment failure on lens module during calibration phase. Required field service engineer dispatch.
Mass flow controller sensor mismatch causing deposition thickness deviations. MFC replaced.
Camera calibration drift on laser lens unit. Realigned and recalibrated.
Overcurrent fault on joint 3 motor. Cleared debris and checked cabling.
Spindle vibration exceeded warning threshold. Tightened mounts.
Cooling water pump motor failed to start due to contactor damage. Replacement ordered.
Transformer core temperature exceeded safe limit. Oil pump service initiated.
Pressure drop in cleanroom delivery line. Located and patched main line leaks.
Chamber chemistry ratio deviation during silicon etch. Re-calibrated mass flow controllers.
HEPA filter differential pressure high and filter change performed.
